agentCursorModule.title: Agent Cursor AI
agentCursorModule.intro: Trigger Cursor AI locally to analyze Git repositories and generate professional documentation. This module launches Cursor AI as a local application to provide the highest quality analysis.
agentCursorModule.placeholderUserPrompt: Enter custom instructions for Cursor AI analysis (optional)
agentCursorModule.how1Rest: Provide a GitHub repository URL to analyze
agentCursorModule.how2Rest: Enter custom instructions for Cursor AI analysis (optional)
agentCursorModule.how3Rest: Click the launch button to start Cursor AI
agentCursorModule.how4Rest: Cursor AI will open locally and analyze the repository
agentCursorModule.how5Rest: Professional README.md will be generated automatically
agentCursorModule.how6Rest: View and save the generated documentation to your Training Library
agentCursorModule.importantNoteRest: This module requires Cursor AI to be installed on your local machine. The system will automatically launch Cursor AI, trigger the documentation generation, and monitor the process until completion.
